## How the before-images were taken

The flow-7 snapshot dates from 2026-10-04 and predates M0-s-01's session rounds S1 and S2, so its hashes are not this
round's before-image. Instead the checker took a census of the item's owns by git blob hash. It hashed every file in
the tree (`sha1("blob <n>\0" + bytes)`) and compared each hash with the hash the GitHub contents API (`gh api`, no git)
reports for `main`. Exactly 18 files of M0-s-01's owns differ: `tools/landed/{snapshot,landed,verify,landed.test}.mjs`,
`tools/notices/{closure,generate,notices.test,shipped.test}.mjs`, `tools/vendor/common.mjs`,
`tools/scaffold/workspace.test.mjs`, `tools/vitest/tiny-sentinel.mjs`, `scripts/{build,lint}.mjs`, `README.md`,
`vitest.config.ts` and `packages/{kernel,model,layout}/src/index.ts`. A 19th, `packages/testkit/src/index.ts`, is
M0-x-06's in-flight edit, named in the brief. Every other owned file (`dev-exceptions.json`, `vendor/{verify,import}.mjs`,
the vendor tests, `launch-browsers.mjs`, `fast-check.setup.mjs`, `bench.mjs`, the workspace configs,
`site`/`tables` index) equals main. The 18 main versions were fetched and blob-verified, and the before mirror `mb` was
built from them: the tree, with those 18 files at main's bytes and fresh `node_modules`. CONFIRMED.

## Mutants (own, mirror `ma` = the tree; one at a time, `--maxWorkers=1 --bail=1`, each restored and compared with the tree)

There were 42 targeted mutants on the consolidated code; 27 went red. The 27 red: A1-sha-neq, A1-del-false,
A1-now-true, A1-status-neq (A-1); A2-false-verify, A2-prefix (A-2); A3-noid, A3-weak (A-3); A4-sep-false, A4-sep-notrim,
A4-seat-neg, A4-seat-off, A4-col-header (A-4); N1-gen-rev, N1-gen-none (N-1); VT1-bcu-rev (byCodeUnit reversed: the lock
and audit form); MA5-nocopy, MA5-nobuild, MA5-bytes, MA5-out, MA5-root (S-2's pin); F1-order, F1-drop, F3-weak
(F-1, F-3); C-0124's graph mutants G124-model-ref (model referencing tables, not kernel), G124-tk-ref (a layout test
project referencing the test kit), G124-excl (a test project's `fixtures/**` exclusion dropped). The baseline of the
seven test files in the mirror is green: 110 tests.

Of the 15 survivors, two are judged **equivalent**:
* A1-swap (`sameEntry(now, entry)`): an entry is either `{ symlink }` or `{ sha256, size }`, so a mixed pair compares
  false either way.
* VT1-walk-rev: the final full-path sort makes `listFiles`' result independent of the walk's per-folder order.

The other 13 were **replayed on main's code** in `mb`, each as the same mutation written into the old copies (both
copies where the old code had two), and **each survives there too**: A1-sym-true, A1-sym-sha, A1-undef-true,
A1-del-true, A2-false-landed, A2-nested, A4-sep-true, A4-sep-undef, A4-seat-loose, A4-ledger-cont, A4-col-sep,
N1-clo-rev, N1-clo-ver. So the consolidation lost no kill. These are pre-existing pin gaps, and J273 Q1 lets no pin but
MA5's ride this round. N1-clo-rev is caught by the common oracle all the same: it reverses the `lint licences: dev
exceptions:` line, CONFIRMED by `checkLicencesOf()` under the mutant. Filed: the author's N-17 – N-19 and this
checker's N-20. None is a blocker: each one's behaviour is right today by reading and by the old-vs-new comparison over
the real tree.
